The specification is revised and re-validated (all checklist items still pass). **We're still at the spec gate — please review the updated spec before we move to planning.**

## 📄 Revised specification ready for review

- **Spec file**: `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`
- **Checklist**: all items pass ✅

### Every one of your corrections is now folded in

| Your requirement | Where it landed |
|---|---|
| Auto-collect title, description, favicon, preview; edit title & description | Story 1 · FR-003, FR-004 |
| Duplicate address → go to existing bookmark, never duplicate | Story 2 · FR-006, FR-007 |
| Personal note in Markdown | Story 7 · FR-008, FR-009 |
| Search over title/description/note/address, case-insensitive, `#tag`, quoted phrases, AND/OR/NOT, parentheses | Story 4 · FR-014–FR-018 |
| Suggest existing tags while typing | Story 6 · FR-021 |
| Read-later state + separate unread view + mark read | Story 5 · FR-023–FR-025 |
| Sorting; multi-select bulk actions; same actions on whole filtered view | Stories 3 & 8 · FR-011, FR-026–FR-028 |
| Archive separate from delete; own view; restorable | Story 9 · FR-029–FR-032 |
| Saved reusable views (search + included/excluded tags) | Story 10 · FR-033, FR-034 |
| Browser import/export preserving titles, tags, original dates | Story 11 · FR-035–FR-037 |
| Local snapshots, PDFs as PDFs, Internet Archive option | Story 12 · FR-038–FR-041 |
| Display prefs: default sort, items shown, font size | Story 13 · FR-042 |

### A few defaults I chose — flag any you'd change

- **Duplicate detection** treats trivial differences (trailing slash, host letter case) as the same address (FR-007). Tell me if you want stricter (exact-match only) or looser matching.
- **Import format**: standard browser bookmark **HTML** file, with folders mapped to tags (Assumptions). Say if you also need JSON or a specific browser's format.
- **Internet Archive** is treated as an external service that fails gracefully — it won't block saving. This session can't reach external connectors, but that only affects live testing later, not the spec.
- Still **single-user, no accounts**, browser-based — unchanged, as you confirmed.

### Your options at this gate

1. **Approve** → I proceed to `speckit-plan`.
2. **Adjust** → name what to change and I'll revise the spec again (still no code).

This is a large, ambitious v1 — if you'd like, I can also propose a **phased release** (P1 stories as the first shippable slice, then P2/P3) during planning. Would you like to approve, or refine anything first?
